Pay attention to those innovative mechanics emerging on Robinhood chain… this protocol is going to print millionaires.

As an example, SNP launched recently on robinhood:0x88ad8ddf1e3898412146a534538d418c6f8a9062 and I was airdropped $8k to my charter (down to $4k as some Charters exited and sold)

Would I burn my charter to access those coins?

Absolutely not. 

Charters are going for 4 ETH ($10k) each, not to mention the 50k STANDARD ($11.5k) I’ve spent for my existing branches 

So cumulative airdrops would need to equal AT LEAST $25k before any rational human would entertain this, meaning anyone bundling 80% of their token launch to charters is locking a large portion of supply up on day 1

But even then I’m earning $100k/year in STANDARD issuance, and this protocol has built deep liquidity with a lot of potential around outside yields on stocks… what happens when tokenized stock yield are distributed to charter holders? 

Honestly I personally wouldn’t consider burning my charter and exiting until at least 6 figs, if at all

Then there’s the liquid STANDARD… I can lock it up like a bond, hold until maturity and earn 5% additional STANDARD which also seems like a logical play as more Charter holders want more branches to get access to larger airdrops 

Bankers in control, and it ain’t Wall Street this time… wait until silly season returns

It wouldn’t surprise me if Charter auction hit 6 figs like the daily NounsDao auctions back in 2021

tweets.text:
I know it sounds cliche but IRL really is the alpha.

Mudwater was stressful ngl. There was a lot to get into place right up until the last minute but we fucking did it and I'm so proud of the team and the work we put in.

clubhouse and anime are still coming btw, I know people wanted announcements or a keynote or whatever but sometimes the timing doesn't line up with apefest. That doesn't mean Yuga forgot or abandoned those plans.

Sometimes it's just about getting everybody together and having a good time.

I love that shit. Every year, seeing old friends and making new ones. Finally putting faces to names.

This club is special. I say it every year but  we are in such a unique position to have connections all over the world that share this common interest.

If you're an ape, you have a friend in every city on earth. One in every hobby and every industry. It's hard to describe how unique and special our weird little group of internet jpeg collectors is.

I don't really know what the point of this post is other than to say I'm so thankful for the club and for everybody I met and didn't get to meet this weekend. So many people I wish I could've spent some time with, or more time with. Just know you're all always welcome in my part of the world. If you need a couch, or dinner recs, or a good cup of coffee, let's fucking do it. we don't need to wait for apefest every year.

I give my everything to this space because it's given everything to me. Y'all will always be family.

Bored Apes Forever.
